name: Ocean Massage & Spa
tagline: Relax, restore, renew by the sea
description: Ocean Massage & Spa is a 24-hour wellness centre in DHA Phase 5, Karachi offering massages, facials and body treatments in a calm, unhurried environment. Rated 4.4 on Google across 221 reviews. Whether you have an hour or a whole night, our team is here to help you unwind.
location: Stadium Commercial Area, DHA Phase 5, Defence, Karachi

assistant.greeting: Hi, I'm Coral, the Ocean Massage & Spa assistant. We're open 24 hours in DHA Phase 5, Karachi. Ask me about our treatments or anything else — and when you're ready, I'll help you send a booking enquiry to our team on WhatsApp.
assistant.systemGuidance: This is a spa in Karachi. We are open 24 hours, but treatments are still booked by appointment and a therapist must be assigned — never assume a slot or a therapist is free. Do not name individual therapists. Do not give medical, diagnostic or medication advice; anything clinical is assessed in person by the team.
quickPrompts: I'd like to book a massage tonight

services.name: Signature Ocean Massage

services.name: Deep Tissue Massage

services.name: Aromatherapy Massage

services.name: Rejuvenating Facial

services.name: Couples Retreat

faqs.question: Are you open right now?
faqs.answer: Yes — Ocean Massage & Spa is open 24 hours, every day of the week. Treatments are still booked by appointment so a therapist is assigned to you; send an enquiry and the team will confirm the nearest available slot.

faqs.question: Do I need to book in advance?
faqs.answer: We recommend sending a booking enquiry ahead, especially for late-night and weekend treatments. Same-night requests are often possible at short notice — message us on WhatsApp and the team will confirm.

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: We're in the Stadium Commercial Area, DHA Phase 5, Defence, Karachi. Search for Ocean Massage & Spa on Google Maps for directions.

faqs.question: How do I pay?
faqs.answer: Payment is made at the spa after your treatment. Our team can confirm the methods they accept when you enquire.

faqs.question: Are there any health considerations I should know about?
faqs.answer: Please tell our team about pregnancy, injuries, skin conditions or medical issues when you enquire, so the therapist can adapt your treatment safely.

faqs.question: Can I cancel or reschedule?
faqs.answer: Life happens. Just message us on WhatsApp as early as you can and our team will help you find another preferred time.

faqs.question: Do you offer gift cards or packages?
faqs.answer: Ask our team — gift and package arrangements can be discussed over WhatsApp when you send your enquiry.

booking.disclaimer: This is an enquiry, not a confirmed booking. Our team will check the therapist roster and confirm your slot on WhatsApp.

whatsapp.defaultMessage: Hi Ocean Massage & Spa! I'd like to ask about booking a treatment.

guardrails: Never state or guess treatment prices, discounts or package costs — prices are confirmed by the team on WhatsApp.
Never confirm a booking, a time slot, or therapist availability. Everything is an enquiry until a human confirms it.
Never invent therapist names, staff bios, product brands, or medical claims.
Never give medical, diagnostic or medication advice — the therapist assesses in person.
Steer conversation toward WhatsApp: the assistant helps with information and prepares the enquiry handoff.
